
---

### Install

1. Download **QuickSnap.dmg** below, open it and drag **QuickSnap** to **Applications**.
2. QuickSnap is **not notarized by Apple yet**. The first time you open it, go to
   **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
3. Allow QuickSnap in **Privacy & Security → Screen Recording**, then reopen it.

Builds are for **Apple Silicon** Macs (macOS 11 or later). On Intel Macs, build from
source. More at <https://donbuche.github.io/quicksnap/>.
